request.subject: PORTRAIT:MARTIAN:KNIGHT

layers.text: Make it a bigger, grander command ship that fills the image: a very wide thick chrome disc in two stacked tiers with a ring of many small hot magenta lights, three small chrome fins on top, a glass dome with a short antenna and no pilot, and under it one big round beam port glowing hot magenta. Keep the silver-white chrome colours, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
